Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: ONE square head-and-shoulders NPC portrait asset for Bagyong Bahay, for a dialogue frame displayed at 150px. New illustration for design approval, no text or sheet.
Image 1 is the actual 3D MODEL identity reference: match that character's hair, face silhouette, apparent age, skin tone, clothing and accessories. Image 2 is ONLY the approved player's rendering STYLE and frame reference. Do NOT give every adult the player's haircut or child face.
Render a new original 2D portrait with the same broad angular cel-shaded planes, controlled dark contour, polygonal hair masses, expressive dark eyes with restrained small highlights, matte worn-print texture and storm-muted palette as Image2. Translate low-poly models into illustrated faces, never retain photographic/model-render textures. Clearly adult when applicable; do not make all characters teenagers. Restrained texture, uncluttered features readable at150px. Frontal centered gaze, head upper-shoulders crop, hair top inset, face about60–65% image height. Identical square composition and outer charcoal/teal frame plus fine ivory inset to Image2. Broad diffuse light from upper-left. Quiet low contrast illustrated background with3–5 broad shapes in desaturated olive, teal/charcoal, soft grey; background must not compete with face.
Expression: neutral/attentive, mouth closed, relaxed but engaged brows. Each character will have separately generated expression variants later. Opaque square full-canvas PNG master about1024px. No text, numbers, brands, logos, watermark, title, UI button, hands, extra characters, photo background, glossy3D/plastic, photoreal skin, crayon scribbles, scanlines, chromatic aberration, neon, fantasy or combat imagery. No unreferenced jewelry or hats; keep actual model's traits.
